title: Tytuvėnai Monastery Granary

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified open elevation tile data sampled at the independent building anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: Lithuanian GRPK registry footprint and individual Cultural Heritage Register location
mapIdentity.scope: The register locates the granary in the west part of the contiguous record. Its 20.20 m length fixes the shared boundary with the 24.17 m east servants’ house.

note: Two-storey plastered granary with stone foundations, a half-hipped roof, round end openings and a west arched doorway.
